description: Verify that TCP in ESTABLISHED sends a FIN segment when the local user issues a CLOSE call (RFC 793 §3.5 p38)
approach:
[Objective]
The canonical active-close trigger: from ESTABLISHED, user CLOSE → FIN on the wire and FIN-WAIT-1 entry.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester (UT) → DUT: CLOSE call.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: FIN.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted FIN observed.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_dut_fin — DUT did not emit FIN on CLOSE

verdicts.Pass: DUT emitted FIN on CLOSE from ESTABLISHED — normal
